messages:
aj: Heads up — PR #42042 is blocked on a flaky CI failure in the test suite. Seeing intermittent failures on the embed-indexer smoke test on linux-shard-7.
aj: Can someone give a quick +1 for a targeted rerun or help triage? I don't want to hold the merge window.

ci-bot: buildkite: PR #42042 — linux-shard-7 FAILED (embed-indexer-test)
ci-bot: recent failures: 3/10 flakes. Last error snippet:\n```
E   AssertionError: expected 200 but got 500
  File tests/test_embed_indexer.py:87 in test_indexer_smoke
  RuntimeError: KV shard timeout while writing index
```

camille: @aj thanks for flagging. Looks like that KV timeout is the intermittent one we saw earlier today. If it's only shard-7 we can do a targeted rerun for the shard. If it reproduces across shards we should bisect.

sanjay: I can approve the quick rerun. @aj please add the `--targeted-shard=7` flag to the rerun command (so we don't waste CI cycles).

aj: copying the rerun command here:`/buildkite rerun --pr 42042 --targeted-shard 7` — does that look right? also pinging @olivia for snapshot note, this PR touches a serializer.

olivia: That command is fine. Quick check: the failure looks runtime (timeout) not snapshot. If the rerun passes we can merge. If it consistently fails we may need to update a flaky test guard or increase KV client timeout. :thinking_face:

sanjay: +1 (approved). Triggering rerun now.

sanjay: /buildkite rerun --pr 42042 --targeted-shard 7

ci-bot: buildkite: rerun queued for PR #42042 (targeted: shard-7). Estimated start in ~2m.

aj: thank you! I'll watch the run and will merge if green. If it flakes again I'll open a follow-up to add a retry wrapper around that test.

olivia: sounds good. ping me if you open the follow-up, I can help with the timeout tuning.

aj: :thumbsup:
